why_a_companion_and_not_an_edit: the rule file asserts it was frozen before any cross-entropy existed. Editing it would muddy that claim even though it is still true, so this is a SECOND pre-number document with its own timestamp and the rule file stays byte-unchanged. It adds no threshold and changes no branch condition; it fixes how two already-named branches are READ.
frozen_before: any cross-entropy from either new checkpoint existed, and before wiki/glm_residual_leak_2026-11-24.json was written -- the probe was at 25 of 120 windows on its first arm when this was frozen
credit: both items raised by a sibling Claude session (Soraya Development) reviewing the running probe's design. The corpus-size arithmetic is theirs; the extension that validates it against a published figure is this session's.

ONE_the_corpus_size_confound_measured_no.objection: longest-common-substring against a random corpus grows with corpus size, so a SMALLER corpus has a LOWER chance level. A fall toward chance in the representative arm could therefore be an artifact of having removed 3,463 windows rather than of having removed E. coli. This is the first objection a reader will raise and it was not named in the rule.
ONE_the_corpus_size_confound_measured_no.expected_random_lcs_formula: log4(N_chars * L_query) -- the query's own L start positions each get a shot at the corpus, so omitting L under-predicts
ONE_the_corpus_size_confound_measured_no.shift_is_formula_independent: L cancels in a difference of logs, so log4(N) and log4(N*L) give the SAME 0.0402 bp shift. The formula choice matters for the LEVEL, not for this confound.
ONE_the_corpus_size_confound_measured_no.the_chance_model_is_validated_not_assert: log4(N*L) predicts 15.21 bp for the committed corpus and wiki/glm_copying_penalty_2026-11-22.json measured a uniform-random median of 15.0 bp. An independently measured figure reproducing the formula is what licenses using it here. log4(N) alone predicts 11.60 and under-predicts by ~3.6 bp.
ONE_the_corpus_size_confound_measured_no.verdict: the measurable range is 55.0 bp observed down to 15.0 bp chance = 40.0 bp. A 5.4% smaller corpus spends 0.0402 bp of that, which is 0.10%. A fall toward chance CANNOT be a corpus-size artifact.
ONE_the_corpus_size_confound_measured_no.and_the_design_is_paired_anyway: the same 120 windows are scored against both corpora, so this confound would have to act within a window rather than across samples.

channel_1_verbatim_memorisation.what: the model has seen the literal string and can reproduce it
channel_1_verbatim_memorisation.status: this is the RIGHT instrument for this channel, not a limited proxy, because memorisation is of exact strings. The probe covers channel 1 cleanly.
channel_1_verbatim_memorisation.correction_to_my_own_honest_limit: the rule's limit note read as though LCS were a weak proxy for one thing. It is a STRONG instrument for channel 1 and BLIND to channel 2. That is a sharper and more useful statement than `bounds exact DNA, does not prove absence of homology`, which is true but files a second measurable channel under caveat.

channel_2_homology_mediated_transfer.what: a 90%-identical homolog in training teaches the local statistics, so the model effectively knows the window without ever copying it. This is REAL leakage for this task.
channel_2_homology_mediated_transfer.status: structurally invisible to any substring measure, so the probe says nothing about it
channel_2_homology_mediated_transfer.where_it_is_actually_measured: the reading rule's CROSS_ORGANISM_COST_DOMINATES branch is this channel seen from the far side -- `the model got much worse than the 0.0054 leak predicts` is what removing same-genus homology looks like.

TWO_there_are_two_leak_channels_and_they.so_the_two_documents_are_complementary_i: the probe and the reading rule measure the two channels, rather than being one measurement plus one caveat.

THE_ANTI_MISREAD_CLAUSE_the_reason_this_.the_pattern: probe lands NEAR CHANCE and the model comes back WORSE BY MUCH MORE than +0.0054
THE_ANTI_MISREAD_CLAUSE_the_reason_this_.wrong_reading: a contradiction, or evidence that one of the two measurements is broken
THE_ANTI_MISREAD_CLAUSE_the_reason_this_.correct_reading: jointly coherent: the VERBATIM channel is closed and the HOMOLOGY channel is carrying the cost. Both can be true at once and together they are more informative than either alone.
THE_ANTI_MISREAD_CLAUSE_the_reason_this_.why_pre_registered: this is the easiest misread available on these two results and naming it after seeing them would be indistinguishable from fitting the story to the numbers.

TWO_there_are_two_leak_channels_and_they.the_named_disambiguator: a Klebsiella-substituted corpus restores same-genus homology while still containing no E. coli, which separates channel 2 from channel 1. The builder's blind rule produces exactly this if the E. coli SPECIES is excluded, because Klebsiella pneumoniae shares E. coli's lineage key Pseudomonadota;Gammaproteobacteria and 17 of its assemblies are in data/refseq_cache. This reframes it from `confounded follow-up` to `the instrument for channel 2`, and it is NOT part of the current arm.

a_transferable_rule_from_the_same_exchan.rule: a grep negative is only evidence about RECORDED facts. For a COMPUTED quantity, the absence of a hit carries no information at all -- stop searching and start recomputing.
a_transferable_rule_from_the_same_exchan.provenance: this session searched every tracked text file for a figure another session was blocked on and correctly found nothing; that session then reproduced it on the first attempt by testing candidate definitions against the data. Both were right and were answering different questions.
a_transferable_rule_from_the_same_exchan.same_shape_as: a probe returning nothing because it cannot see the thing, rather than because the thing is absent -- the vacuous-guard failure mode this repo has recorded several times.
